If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

step_variables._configuration_schema:
[
  {
    "title": "Fetch Alerts Since",
    "required": true,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "type": "datetime",
    "name": "start_datetime",
    "sub_title": "Select a date and time to retrieve alerts from the ElasticSearch server for the specified time.",
    "tooltip": "Specify the timeframe in minutes to pull the alert from the ElasticSearch server for the first time."
  },
  {
    "title": "Status",
    "name": "status",
    "type": "select",
    "description": "Specify the alert status by which you want to filter the alerts.",
    "tooltip": "Specify the alert status by which you want to filter the alerts.",
    "required": false,
    "visible": true,
    "editable": true,
    "options": [
      "open",
      "in-progress",
      "acknowledged",
      "closed"
    ],
    "value": "open"
  },
  {
    "title": "Maximum Records to Fetch",
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "visible": true,
    "type": "integer",
    "name": "size",
    "value": 100,
    "tooltip": "The maximum number of records to return.",
    "description": "Maximum number of records that this operation should return."
  }
]
